name: Duryea Farms
description: Duryea Farms grows Apples, Pumpkins, Tomatoes, and Peppers in Chestnut Ridge, NY. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
